name: vendor.myndhyve.market-intel-shift-detect
description: MyndHyve market-intel.shift-detect — the WIRED version of MyndHyve's Partial MarketShiftDetectionService. A DETERMINISTIC diff (no AI call) of two prior market-research run artifacts → a MarketShiftAlert: new / resolved / intensified pain points, angle-score deltas, and intent-stage shifts. Pure transform ⇒ replay/fork-safe. Extends the insights-suite variance-compute pattern for the market-intel cohort.
author: MyndHyve

nodes.label: Detect market shift
nodes.description: Diff two market-research result sets (previous vs current) into a MarketShiftAlert. Inputs: { previous: { records?, angles? }, current: { records?, angles? } } where records = VoC records ({ quote, tagType }) and angles = scored angles ({ id|name, score }). Output: { alert: { newPains[], resolvedPains[], intensifiedPains[], angleDeltas[], summary, hasShift } }. Deterministic set/score diff — NO AI call, NO side effects; pure transform.
